Name: Portrait Mod Image Template
Author: HeadInTheCloudsMods
Description:
literally just a few PNGs to use as guides to know where to put your art.  

[size=4][b]Guide: [/b][/size]
By default (some mods can change this), all portraits are 64x64 pixels, arranged in two columns going as far down as one likes, though most vanilla NPCs stop well before 7 rows. The standard amount of portraits to have is 6, in three rows, as follows:
[img width=280]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/55097/55097-1793930860-119907301.png[/img][img width=280]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/55097/55097-1793930861-1710805231.png[/img][img width=280]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/55097/55097-1793930860-2057083651.png[/img]
[i]Note: Irritatingly a large amount of vanilla NPCs do not follow this standard order (which makes sense for an indie game made by one person ofc), but the romanceables do, and thus it's been adopted as standard in the modding community. [/i]

The '$' shown correspond to the portrait command used to show that expression during dialog ([url=https://stardewvalleywiki.com/Modding:Dialogue#:~:text=good%20morning%20Ms.%20%40!-,Portrait%20commands,-%5Bedit%5D]wiki guide on that here[/url]). 


[center][i]100% of DP earned by this mod go to Doctors Without Borders[/i][/center]
